title: Integration tests run against a disposable local instance of the production database engine and topology
context: The integration tier ran a standalone in-memory MongoDB, which has no transactions, while production Atlas is a replica set. A fix that makes team creation atomic would have no way to be proven.
decision: Integration tests run against a local, disposable instance of the same database engine and topology as production, started for each test file and discarded after it. For MongoDB Atlas that is an in-memory replica set (MongoMemoryReplSet). Hosted databases are used only by end-to-end and API smoke tests. Auth services stay DI doubles in this tier.

alternatives.reason: It has no transactions, so an atomic write cannot be tested.
CI would need network access and secrets, and tests could interfere with each other.

consequences: Starting each integration test file takes a few seconds longer.
revisitTriggers: The production database changes engine or topology: the principle stands, and a new record replaces the tool.
